caption: The drawing depicts the face of a clock with a rectangular base and a rounded arch at the top. The clock face has a mottled background with hues of yellow, brown, and green. It features large Roman numerals in black, marking the hours from I to XII, with smaller Arabic numerals marking increments of five along the outer edge (from 5 to 60). There are three ornate, black clock hands, two large and one small, positioned at various points. The area above the center axis contains an inscription reading “Beach & Ward HARTFORD” inside an outlined oval. Decorative black flourishes adorn each corner of the clock face. Near the bottom center of the face is a circular motif with symmetrical, compass-like designs. The surrounding paper is plain and cream-colored, and the artist's signature, “Geoffrey Holt,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Grandfather Clock Dial
